name: Laaca Gaming
description: Uruguayan WooCommerce store for PC gaming hardware and peripherals, gaming PCs, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch consoles and accessories, and VR headsets. Prices shown in US dollars; ships across Uruguay and offers pickup in Montevideo.
description_es: Tienda uruguaya en WooCommerce de hardware y periféricos gamer, PCs gamer, consolas PlayStation, Xbox y Nintendo Switch con accesorios, y lentes de realidad virtual. Precios en dólares; envía a todo Uruguay y ofrece retiro en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Ships anywhere in Uruguay; same-day delivery in Montevideo depends on stock, time and zone; interior shipping arranged by available carrier.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the Montevideo store after the order is confirmed.

shopping_notes: Prices show separate amounts for cash or transfer and for cards. Stock and delivery type are shown per product page.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping, same-day Montevideo delivery, pickup
